svg.title: Chart of yearly cost by AllCoaching plan against yearly sales: Starter at 10% lowest below about ₹7.3 lakh, Growth at 0% commission paid yearly lowest above that; Pro and monthly billing shown as flat lines
svg.text: Yearly cost = plan price + platform fee on sales, before GST. Monthly billing × 12.
Solid = Starter and plans paid yearly, dashed = paid monthly. Shaded blue = lowest cost. Illustrative, ex-GST.
